title: arenaria tenuifolia var. hybrida
intro: Arenaria tenuifolia var. hybrida, commonly known as Sandwort or Sea Pink, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria tenuifolia var. hybrida include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-edematous effects, making it a popular ingredient in traditional remedies for skin issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential therapeutic applications.
